summary: Ibex SG13G2/EZ130 RTL-to-GDS on a 4-vCPU cloud host: RustEDA native flow against LibreLane 3.0.17 with the same prepared inputs and the same independent gate scripts, plus module head-to-heads.

design.rtl_note: sv2v 0.0.13.1 output; the 2026-10-30 campaign's file was 8a8fe84b… (different sv2v build)

technology.standard_cell_library: EZ130 8T v1.1 (tech LEF and GDS reconstructed; see ez130_files)
technology.ez130_summary: 5 of 7 contract-pinned EZ130 files byte-identical; SG13G2 tech LEF and GDS reconstructed; the catalog-pinned FF Liberty is also byte-identical

host.cgroup: v1 memory controller; each timed stage alone in its own child group
host.allocation: all 4 vCPUs to each flow; RustEDA 8 GiB cap (+2 GiB memsw), LibreLane 10 GiB cap; no swap device
host.sampling: one timed sample per flow; module stages one warm-up plus three measured repetitions
host.facts_source: captured on the campaign host on 2026-11-05 before the timed campaign (superproject cf44eaa; /proc/cpuinfo, sysconf, uname, lscpu in host-lscpu.txt); engine commits are the gitlinks pinned by cf44eaa, from which every engine binary was built

RustEDA.configuration: repository recipe (integration/ibex_sg13g2_ez130 at the campaign commit), composed by compose_native.py; grouped single-process antenna session; RustROAD frontend placement, CTS at --threads 2; route, extract, post-route repair, antenna repair at --threads 4; export-gds on the default 2-thread pool (no --threads); producer foundry checks on the schedule in foundry_check_schedule; unqualified

latchup.scope: tap_coverage.py: LU.a and LU.b, 20 um, conservative L1 box certificate

RustEDA.end_to_end_scope: sv2v preparation + producer (synthesis through extraction, OpenRCX and RustSTA/OpenSTA signoff timing, and the foundry main/antenna DRC and LVS when it reaches them, on the producer's own schedule: see foundry_check_schedule) + shared gates the producer did not run as the identical check (see completion_gates: of foundry main and antenna DRC, latch-up, LVS, vendor simulation, synthesis/final equivalence, density); end_to_end_seconds_serial_checks charges the producer's covered checks their serial sum instead of their elapsed span

determinism.reference_run: second native producer run after the timed campaign (identical composition, binaries and host copy; idle host; through be_timing, which writes every compared artifact)
determinism.note: artifact identity across two native producer runs (reference_run names the second); the OpenRCX SPEF is written by OpenROAD

LibreLane.configuration: LibreLane 3.0.17 Classic flow through Checker.XOR, prepared contract config, DRT_THREADS=4, RUN_POST_GRT_DESIGN_REPAIR=true (LibreLane's own post-GRT repair instead of the historical RustEDA-authored DRV ECO loop)

latchup.scope: tap_coverage.py: LU.a and LU.b, 20 um, conservative L1 box certificate

LibreLane.equivalence_checker_note: obligation export: 433 implementation states lack a unique named RTL counterpart; first _21851_ (DFFRQX1)
LibreLane.end_to_end_scope: sv2v preparation + LibreLane flow through Checker.XOR + every shared gate (foundry main and antenna DRC, OpenRCX, RustSTA/OpenSTA timing, latch-up, LVS, vendor simulation, equivalence, density), one gate at a time; end_to_end_seconds_native_check_schedule charges the shared gates the native producer covered under the producer's schedule (RustEDA foundry_check_schedule: lanes side by side) instead of their serial sum

synthesis.task: prepared Ibex RTL (sv2v) to EZ130 TT + SRAM Liberty mapped netlist

extraction.thread_note: RustROAD sizes its thread pool from --threads (default 2; RAYON_NUM_THREADS does not size it); module_bench.py sets --threads to each listed value on the recorded extract command, so the _t2 and _t4 rows ran 2 and 4 threads (the flow's be_extract: --threads 4). OpenRCX used set_thread_count 2 and 4.

timing.scope: RustSTA: init+import+run (TT and SS in one run)+8 reports; OpenSTA: one process per corner (read, link, SDC, SPEF, full reports)

gds.thread_note: RustROAD export-gds replays the recorded be_gds command (no --threads: default 2-thread pool); KLayout's LEF/DEF reader is single-process.

ratios.eligibility: not eligible: a flow failed or left a gate unverified; see gates
ratios.end_to_end_convention: end_to_end_speedup charges LibreLane's shared main/antenna DRC and LVS on the native producer's check schedule (foundry_check_schedule); end_to_end_speedup_serial_checks charges both flows those checks one after another

deviations: EZ130 SG13G2 tech LEF and cell GDS reconstructed from public sources (not byte-identical to the pinned archive)
nixpkgs tool builds (OpenROAD 26Q3, Yosys 0.70) instead of LibreLane's pinned OpenROAD dcf36133 / Yosys 0.62
native recipe composed without component-qualification evidence: eight derived qualification gates not produced
native recipe is the repository recipe of the campaign commit; the R20/R21 recipe inputs are not published
host-local helper patches: thread allow-lists (4), cgroup-v1 ownership, RC-profile rules path, density DEF parser
LibreLane without the historical RustEDA-authored repair loop; its own post-GRT design repair enabled
4 vCPUs (Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.80GHz) instead of 16 logical CPUs of an i9-13900HX
publication_rule: Only complete independently checked runs with frozen matching inputs may populate end-to-end comparative ratios. Module head-to-heads report each contender's measured time on the identical task. Failed runs are preserved and reported; missing values stay null.
